payload.summary: Reaper mints orphan-signals for tasks that COMPLETED successfully. The S2 dispatch convention deliberately leaves the sprint-task lock unreleased on the success path (ttl_seconds is the bound), so every successful background dispatch eventually produces a spurious orphan-signal when its TTL lapses. Adoption has no terminal-state guard, so a dev-team tick will re-run PO-signed-off archived work.
